operation.summary: Bring Bridgit itself forward using the owner-granted app.foreground scope

body.name: reason
body.description: Required 1-256 character audit reason; 1-second minimum interval, maximum 12 switches/minute

operation.example: POST /v1/app/foreground {"reason":"Restart screenshot service for the morning review"}
operation.returns: durable v2 operation; result.foreground is observed requested target visibility, notification_posted is a fallback requiring an owner tap; error=foreground_user_action_required|foreground_not_confirmed|device_locked when not visible; platform=android; never unlocks or grants Android consent

reason.description: Required 1-256 character audit reason; 1-second minimum interval, maximum 12 switches/minute

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice
